text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Even after demonstrating her power in the 
Satsuki Sho, Sirius Symboli's running 
showed not a single ounce of hesitation.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Her stoic devotion to training brushed 
aside all speculation that she might be 
harboring a hint of loneliness regarding 
Symboli Rudolf.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Sirius Symboli's true goal is to 
eventually shine brilliantly at the 
pinnacle of the world.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
However, setting everything else aside, 
the first goal was to secure victory in 
the upcoming Japanese Derby.
